_meta.description: State revenue authority directory (brief §4-7, §22, §32). verification_status reflects how each row was actually obtained — this file does NOT claim uniform verification. FULLY_RESEARCHED means a human/agent browsed the live official site and read its content directly (done for Enugu as the required first fully-integrated state, plus the federal layer researched separately in REGULATORY_RESEARCH_REPORT.md). WEBSITE_CONFIRMED means the official domain and authority name were cross-checked via a direct web search returning the authority's own site. LOCATED_SECONDARY_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED means the website/name came from a third-party aggregator (a 2026 tax-portal directory blog) and has NOT yet been independently confirmed against the state's own site — brief §6 requires this distinction to be preserved, not collapsed into a false 'verified'. No tax RATE, THRESHOLD, or DEADLINE for any state other than federal law and Enugu's named legislation is asserted anywhere in this file — those remain 'Requires regulatory verification' per brief §6/§31 until a human researches each state's actual revenue law with the same rigor as the federal pass.
_meta.aggregator_source_used_for_location_only: https://nrsportal.ng/nigeria-36-states-tax-portal-directory-2026/ (third-party blog — used only to LOCATE candidate URLs per brief §2, not as authority for any rule)

states.filing_deadlines: PAYE: 10th day of month following deduction (PITA s.81). Direct Assessment (self-employed): on or before 31 March annually (PITA s.41).
states.payment_deadlines: Same as filing deadlines above for PAYE/Direct Assessment — not independently separated on the public site.

business_related_taxes_observed: Personal Income Tax — PAYE (Section 81, Personal Income Tax Act CAP P8 LFN 2011): employer remits by 10th day of month following deduction
Personal Income Tax — Direct Assessment for self-employed (Section 41, Personal Income Tax Act CAP P8 LFN 2004): annual return due on or before 31 March, self-assessed, no demand notice required

Withholding Tax (Personal Income Tax Act CAP P8 LFN 2004 + the 2024 Withholding Tax Regulations) — LIRS publishes the same WHT rate table as the federal 2024 Regs (confirmed via direct PDF: corporate/non-corporate resident/non-resident columns, e.g. dividend/interest 10% all categories, royalty 10%/10%/5%/5%, commission/consultancy/technical/management/professional fees 5%/10%/5%/10%)

Capital Gains Tax (individuals only) — Capital Gains Tax Act CAP C1 LFN 2004 as amended: 10% on gains from disposal of chargeable assets, including compensation for loss of office EXCEEDING N10,000,000
Stamp Duties (individuals only) — Stamp Duty Act CAP S8 LFN 2004 as amended: rate varies per instrument

Hotel Occupancy and Restaurant Consumption Tax (HORCT) — Hotel Occupancy and Restaurant Consumption Law 2009: 5% of total bill (excluding VAT and Service Charge), charged to consumers, collected by hotels/bars/restaurants/event centres as agents. LIRS operates a distinct 'Fiscalization for HORCT' programme (electronic fiscal device/receipting requirement for collecting businesses).
Business Premises Levy — Urban: N10,000 initial registration + N5,000/yr renewal. Rural: N2,000 initial registration + N1,000/yr renewal.

Development Levy (individuals only) — flat N100/yr for all taxable individuals resident in the state. NOTE: this is a DISTINCT, much smaller state-specific levy from the federal NTA 2025 company-level Development Levy already modelled elsewhere in this system — same name, unrelated tax base, do not conflate.
states.electronic_receipting: Confirmed for HORCT specifically via a dedicated 'Fiscalization for HORCT' programme (electronic fiscal device requirement) — not confirmed for other tax types
states.api_notes: No developer documentation, sandbox, or integration API found on the official site. Etax is a citizen/business self-service web application (login required, not attempted/bypassed), not a documented machine-to-machine API. A LagosTaxAuthorityAdapter must be a manual/guided-filing adapter, same as Enugu.

Business Premises Levy — N10,000 (urban) / N2,000 (rural) initial registration, N5,000 (urban) / N1,000 (rural) annual renewal
Development Levy (individuals only) — flat N100/year, NOT the same tax as the federal company-level Development Levy

states.revenue_authority_name: Federal Capital Territory Internal Revenue Service (FCT-IRS)
states.taxpayer_portal: FCTIRS Self Service Portal / new TaxPortal (taxportal.fctirs.gov.ng) — registration/login-gated, not attempted/bypassed
states.taxpayer_id_scheme: TIN via the national JTB (Joint Tax Board) portal — FCT-IRS redirects BOTH individual and non-individual TIN registration to the JTB Portal rather than operating its own TIN issuance, per the official site's own E-Services section
applicable_laws: FCT Internal Revenue Service Act 2015 — https://fctirs.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/FCT-IRS-Act-2015.pdf (direct PDF link confirmed live 2026-10-07) — the enabling federal Act
Personal Income Tax Act 104 of 1993 / CAP P8 LFN 2004, as amended by the PIT Amendment Act 2011
states.filing_deadlines: PAYE: end of every month (remittance). Filing of annual returns: on or before 31 March. Confirmed: FCT-IRS has in practice granted a one-month extension for individual tax return filing (news notice dated 2026-04-01), so the statutory 31 March date is not always the operative date in a given year.
states.payment_deadlines: Same as filing deadlines above for PAYE — not independently separated on the public site.
states.penalties_interest: Requires regulatory verification — not found in structured, citable form on the public site during this pass
states.verified_by: AI regulatory research pass — live site browsed directly via real browser automation (fctirs.gov.ng: Home, Tax Types pages, footer Documents section)
states.legal_basis_note: UNIQUE among all 36 states + FCT: FCT-IRS was established by the FCT Internal Revenue Service Act 2015, an Act of the National Assembly (federal legislation) — per the Agency's own About page, it is 'the only State Internal Revenue Service in the Country established by the National Assembly' rather than by a state House of Assembly law. This has real governance implications: FCT-IRS's authorising statute sits at a different source tier (federal Act) than every other state's enabling law.
business_related_taxes_observed: Personal Income Tax (PIT) — Personal Income Tax Act 104 of 1993 / CAP P8 LFN 2004 as amended, PIT Amendment Act 2011. Administered under the First Schedule of the FCT-IRS Act 2015.
